name: Marketta-class shuttle
description: The Marketta-class shuttle was a transport shuttle featuring retractable wings and a passenger cabin that could hold at least four individuals. Created during the reign of the New Republic, the shuttle was used by the New Republic's military, and one such Marketta-class shuttle, the Chandrila Moon, carried Leia Organa Solo of the New Republic in 25 ABY to meet with representatives of the Imperial Remnant on the planet Bastion during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
